first_assessment_read_scope: memory-gap-v2 candidate only, two public contracts, own prior freshly authored solver/audit helpers and new v2 code/evidence. Generic public metadata-interface availability notice received; that document was not read before this complete first assessment.

issues.evidence: All supplied rotations balance exact role, status, typed value, present-null, chosen-version/index and decoded-winner histograms marginally across every ID, position and consistently renamed key. Joint nuisance buckets retain conditional status associations; observed majority fractions reach 0.875, versus marginal fractions 0.625 or 0.75. This is an empirical association, not measured model performance.
issues.fix: Limit claims to the verified marginal crossing and disclose residual joint correlations. Add independently crossed schedules if joint nuisance independence becomes a requirement.

issues.evidence: Twelve source families provide 48 base controlled histories with 12–14 events and eight independent queries each. The 768 rows are correlated histories, key/query rotations and renderings. This establishes finite precedence retrieval and matched counterfactuals, not learned persistent memory, associative relevance or efficacy.
issues.fix: Retain bounded proxy scope and source-family counts; evaluate additional mechanism families and actual model outcomes separately if broader claims are needed.

issues.evidence: All 768 absent query answers use truly missing keys. Future-filter witnesses exist on other keys, but future-only absence supplies zero corpus observations. The current absence_control tag is truthful and does not itself promise both absence subtypes.
issues.fix: Report missing-key and future-only absence separately; add a new future-only absence control if that unrepresented subtype is desired.

review_guidance: Corrective issue-topic-informed assessment using my own v1 findings; not a fresh fully blind study. No other reviewer verdicts, producer code/control reports, reference or oracle were read.
review_method: Own prompt-derived typed scan and separate sorted-precedence resolver; full hash/payload/target recomputation; independent property search plus exact supplied-witness validation; all family scope/paired controls, exact typed/provenance histogram crossing and field-order invariance; eight per-row metamorphics and query-local protected probes; substantive actual-agent inspection of every base family and changed mechanism.

Joint nuisance buckets retain conditional status associations; observed majority fractions reach 0.875, versus marginal fractions 0.625 or 0.75. This is an empirical association, not measured model performance.
issues.fix: Limit claims to the verified marginal crossing and disclose residual joint correlations. Add independently crossed schedules if joint nuisance independence becomes a requirement.

issues.evidence: Twelve source families provide 48 base controlled histories with 12–14 events and eight independent queries each. The 768 rows are correlated histories, key/query rotations and renderings. This establishes finite precedence retrieval and matched counterfactuals, not learned persistent memory, associative relevance or efficacy.
issues.fix: Retain bounded proxy scope and source-family counts; evaluate additional mechanism families and actual model outcomes separately if broader claims are needed.

issues.evidence: All 768 absent query answers use truly missing keys. Future-filter witnesses exist on other keys, but future-only absence supplies zero corpus observations. The current absence_control tag is truthful and does not itself promise both absence subtypes.
issues.fix: Report missing-key and future-only absence separately; add a new future-only absence control if that unrepresented subtype is desired.

review_guidance: Corrective issue-topic-informed assessment using my own v1 findings; not a fresh fully blind study. No other reviewer verdicts, producer code/control reports, reference or oracle were read.
review_method: Own prompt-derived typed scan and separate sorted-precedence resolver; full hash/payload/target recomputation; independent property search plus exact supplied-witness validation; all family scope/paired controls, exact typed/provenance histogram crossing and field-order invariance; eight per-row metamorphics and query-local protected probes; substantive actual-agent inspection of every base family and changed mechanism.

Joint nuisance buckets retain conditional status associations; observed majority fractions reach 0.875, versus marginal fractions 0.625 or 0.75. This is an empirical association, not measured model performance.
issues.fix: Limit claims to the verified marginal crossing and disclose residual joint correlations. Add independently crossed schedules if joint nuisance independence becomes a requirement.

issues.evidence: Twelve source families provide 48 base controlled histories with 12–14 events and eight independent queries each. The 768 rows are correlated histories, key/query rotations and renderings. This establishes finite precedence retrieval and matched counterfactuals, not learned persistent memory, associative relevance or efficacy.
issues.fix: Retain bounded proxy scope and source-family counts; evaluate additional mechanism families and actual model outcomes separately if broader claims are needed.

issues.evidence: All 768 absent query answers use truly missing keys. Future-filter witnesses exist on other keys, but future-only absence supplies zero corpus observations. The current absence_control tag is truthful and does not itself promise both absence subtypes.
issues.fix: Report missing-key and future-only absence separately; add a new future-only absence control if that unrepresented subtype is desired.

review_guidance: Corrective issue-topic-informed assessment using my own v1 findings; not a fresh fully blind study. No other reviewer verdicts, producer code/control reports, reference or oracle were read.
review_method: Own prompt-derived typed scan and separate sorted-precedence resolver; full hash/payload/target recomputation; independent property search plus exact supplied-witness validation; all family scope/paired controls, exact typed/provenance histogram crossing and field-order invariance; eight per-row metamorphics and query-local protected probes; substantive actual-agent inspection of every base family and changed mechanism.

Joint nuisance buckets retain conditional status associations; observed majority fractions reach 0.875, versus marginal fractions 0.625 or 0.75. This is an empirical association, not measured model performance.
issues.fix: Limit claims to the verified marginal crossing and disclose residual joint correlations. Add independently crossed schedules if joint nuisance independence becomes a requirement.

issues.evidence: Twelve source families provide 48 base controlled histories with 12–14 events and eight independent queries each. The 768 rows are correlated histories, key/query rotations and renderings. This establishes finite precedence retrieval and matched counterfactuals, not learned persistent memory, associative relevance or efficacy.
issues.fix: Retain bounded proxy scope and source-family counts; evaluate additional mechanism families and actual model outcomes separately if broader claims are needed.

issues.evidence: All 768 absent query answers use truly missing keys. Future-filter witnesses exist on other keys, but future-only absence supplies zero corpus observations. The current absence_control tag is truthful and does not itself promise both absence subtypes.
issues.fix: Report missing-key and future-only absence separately; add a new future-only absence control if that unrepresented subtype is desired.

review_guidance: Corrective issue-topic-informed assessment using my own v1 findings; not a fresh fully blind study. No other reviewer verdicts, producer code/control reports, reference or oracle were read.
review_method: Own prompt-derived typed scan and separate sorted-precedence resolver; full hash/payload/target recomputation; independent property search plus exact supplied-witness validation; all family scope/paired controls, exact typed/provenance histogram crossing and field-order invariance; eight per-row metamorphics and query-local protected probes; substantive actual-agent inspection of every base family and changed mechanism.

Joint nuisance buckets retain conditional status associations; observed majority fractions reach 0.875, versus marginal fractions 0.625 or 0.75. This is an empirical association, not measured model performance.
issues.fix: Limit claims to the verified marginal crossing and disclose residual joint correlations. Add independently crossed schedules if joint nuisance independence becomes a requirement.

issues.evidence: Twelve source families provide 48 base controlled histories with 12–14 events and eight independent queries each. The 768 rows are correlated histories, key/query rotations and renderings. This establishes finite precedence retrieval and matched counterfactuals, not learned persistent memory, associative relevance or efficacy.
issues.fix: Retain bounded proxy scope and source-family counts; evaluate additional mechanism families and actual model outcomes separately if broader claims are needed.

issues.evidence: All 768 absent query answers use truly missing keys. Future-filter witnesses exist on other keys, but future-only absence supplies zero corpus observations. The current absence_control tag is truthful and does not itself promise both absence subtypes.
issues.fix: Report missing-key and future-only absence separately; add a new future-only absence control if that unrepresented subtype is desired.

review_guidance: Corrective issue-topic-informed assessment using my own v1 findings; not a fresh fully blind study. No other reviewer verdicts, producer code/control reports, reference or oracle were read.
review_method: Own prompt-derived typed scan and separate sorted-precedence resolver; full hash/payload/target recomputation; independent property search plus exact supplied-witness validation; all family scope/paired controls, exact typed/provenance histogram crossing and field-order invariance; eight per-row metamorphics and query-local protected probes; substantive actual-agent inspection of every base family and changed mechanism.

Joint nuisance buckets retain conditional status associations; observed majority fractions reach 0.875, versus marginal fractions 0.625 or 0.75. This is an empirical association, not measured model performance.
issues.fix: Limit claims to the verified marginal crossing and disclose residual joint correlations. Add independently crossed schedules if joint nuisance independence becomes a requirement.

issues.evidence: Twelve source families provide 48 base controlled histories with 12–14 events and eight independent queries each. The 768 rows are correlated histories, key/query rotations and renderings. This establishes finite precedence retrieval and matched counterfactuals, not learned persistent memory, associative relevance or efficacy.
issues.fix: Retain bounded proxy scope and source-family counts; evaluate additional mechanism families and actual model outcomes separately if broader claims are needed.

issues.evidence: All 768 absent query answers use truly missing keys. Future-filter witnesses exist on other keys, but future-only absence supplies zero corpus observations. The current absence_control tag is truthful and does not itself promise both absence subtypes.
issues.fix: Report missing-key and future-only absence separately; add a new future-only absence control if that unrepresented subtype is desired.

review_guidance: Corrective issue-topic-informed assessment using my own v1 findings; not a fresh fully blind study. No other reviewer verdicts, producer code/control reports, reference or oracle were read.
review_method: Own prompt-derived typed scan and separate sorted-precedence resolver; full hash/payload/target recomputation; independent property search plus exact supplied-witness validation; all family scope/paired controls, exact typed/provenance histogram crossing and field-order invariance; eight per-row metamorphics and query-local protected probes; substantive actual-agent inspection of every base family and changed mechanism.

Joint nuisance buckets retain conditional status associations; observed majority fractions reach 0.875, versus marginal fractions 0.625 or 0.75. This is an empirical association, not measured model performance.
issues.fix: Limit claims to the verified marginal crossing and disclose residual joint correlations. Add independently crossed schedules if joint nuisance independence becomes a requirement.

issues.evidence: Twelve source families provide 48 base controlled histories with 12–14 events and eight independent queries each. The 768 rows are correlated histories, key/query rotations and renderings. This establishes finite precedence retrieval and matched counterfactuals, not learned persistent memory, associative relevance or efficacy.
issues.fix: Retain bounded proxy scope and source-family counts; evaluate additional mechanism families and actual model outcomes separately if broader claims are needed.

issues.evidence: All 768 absent query answers use truly missing keys. Future-filter witnesses exist on other keys, but future-only absence supplies zero corpus observations. The current absence_control tag is truthful and does not itself promise both absence subtypes.
issues.fix: Report missing-key and future-only absence separately; add a new future-only absence control if that unrepresented subtype is desired.

review_guidance: Corrective issue-topic-informed assessment using my own v1 findings; not a fresh fully blind study. No other reviewer verdicts, producer code/control reports, reference or oracle were read.
review_method: Own prompt-derived typed scan and separate sorted-precedence resolver; full hash/payload/target recomputation; independent property search plus exact supplied-witness validation; all family scope/paired controls, exact typed/provenance histogram crossing and field-order invariance; eight per-row metamorphics and query-local protected probes; substantive actual-agent inspection of every base family and changed mechanism.

Joint nuisance buckets retain conditional status associations; observed majority fractions reach 0.875, versus marginal fractions 0.625 or 0.75. This is an empirical association, not measured model performance.
issues.fix: Limit claims to the verified marginal crossing and disclose residual joint correlations. Add independently crossed schedules if joint nuisance independence becomes a requirement.

issues.evidence: Twelve source families provide 48 base controlled histories with 12–14 events and eight independent queries each. The 768 rows are correlated histories, key/query rotations and renderings. This establishes finite precedence retrieval and matched counterfactuals, not learned persistent memory, associative relevance or efficacy.
issues.fix: Retain bounded proxy scope and source-family counts; evaluate additional mechanism families and actual model outcomes separately if broader claims are needed.

issues.evidence: All 768 absent query answers use truly missing keys. Future-filter witnesses exist on other keys, but future-only absence supplies zero corpus observations. The current absence_control tag is truthful and does not itself promise both absence subtypes.
issues.fix: Report missing-key and future-only absence separately; add a new future-only absence control if that unrepresented subtype is desired.

review_guidance: Corrective issue-topic-informed assessment using my own v1 findings; not a fresh fully blind study. No other reviewer verdicts, producer code/control reports, reference or oracle were read.
review_method: Own prompt-derived typed scan and separate sorted-precedence resolver; full hash/payload/target recomputation; independent property search plus exact supplied-witness validation; all family scope/paired controls, exact typed/provenance histogram crossing and field-order invariance; eight per-row metamorphics and query-local protected probes; substantive actual-agent inspection of every base family and changed mechanism.

Joint nuisance buckets retain conditional status associations; observed majority fractions reach 0.875, versus marginal fractions 0.625 or 0.75. This is an empirical association, not measured model performance.
issues.fix: Limit claims to the verified marginal crossing and disclose residual joint correlations. Add independently crossed schedules if joint nuisance independence becomes a requirement.

issues.evidence: Twelve source families provide 48 base controlled histories with 12–14 events and eight independent queries each. The 768 rows are correlated histories, key/query rotations and renderings. This establishes finite precedence retrieval and matched counterfactuals, not learned persistent memory, associative relevance or efficacy.
issues.fix: Retain bounded proxy scope and source-family counts; evaluate additional mechanism families and actual model outcomes separately if broader claims are needed.

issues.evidence: All 768 absent query answers use truly missing keys. Future-filter witnesses exist on other keys, but future-only absence supplies zero corpus observations. The current absence_control tag is truthful and does not itself promise both absence subtypes.
issues.fix: Report missing-key and future-only absence separately; add a new future-only absence control if that unrepresented subtype is desired.

review_guidance: Corrective issue-topic-informed assessment using my own v1 findings; not a fresh fully blind study. No other reviewer verdicts, producer code/control reports, reference or oracle were read.
review_method: Own prompt-derived typed scan and separate sorted-precedence resolver; full hash/payload/target recomputation; independent property search plus exact supplied-witness validation; all family scope/paired controls, exact typed/provenance histogram crossing and field-order invariance; eight per-row metamorphics and query-local protected probes; substantive actual-agent inspection of every base family and changed mechanism.

Joint nuisance buckets retain conditional status associations; observed majority fractions reach 0.875, versus marginal fractions 0.625 or 0.75. This is an empirical association, not measured model performance.
issues.fix: Limit claims to the verified marginal crossing and disclose residual joint correlations. Add independently crossed schedules if joint nuisance independence becomes a requirement.

issues.evidence: Twelve source families provide 48 base controlled histories with 12–14 events and eight independent queries each. The 768 rows are correlated histories, key/query rotations and renderings. This establishes finite precedence retrieval and matched counterfactuals, not learned persistent memory, associative relevance or efficacy.
issues.fix: Retain bounded proxy scope and source-family counts; evaluate additional mechanism families and actual model outcomes separately if broader claims are needed.

issues.evidence: All 768 absent query answers use truly missing keys. Future-filter witnesses exist on other keys, but future-only absence supplies zero corpus observations. The current absence_control tag is truthful and does not itself promise both absence subtypes.
issues.fix: Report missing-key and future-only absence separately; add a new future-only absence control if that unrepresented subtype is desired.

review_guidance: Corrective issue-topic-informed assessment using my own v1 findings; not a fresh fully blind study. No other reviewer verdicts, producer code/control reports, reference or oracle were read.
review_method: Own prompt-derived typed scan and separate sorted-precedence resolver; full hash/payload/target recomputation; independent property search plus exact supplied-witness validation; all family scope/paired controls, exact typed/provenance histogram crossing and field-order invariance; eight per-row metamorphics and query-local protected probes; substantive actual-agent inspection of every base family and changed mechanism.
